# Hadoop shell; configured HDFS and permissions required.
# Run in a dedicated lab; this is not browser SQL.
hdfs dfs -mkdir -p /user/studylab/hadoop-lab/input
# Prepare a small local events.txt first; upload only fictional data.
hdfs dfs -put events.txt /user/studylab/hadoop-lab/input/
hdfs dfs -ls /user/studylab/hadoop-lab/input
hdfs dfs -cat /user/studylab/hadoop-lab/input/events.txt
# Existing files are not overwritten by this example.
